svg.aria-label: Who does what: you and your agent on Opus 5.5 discuss and write the Plan; the orchestrator you start with one command writes no code and hands each slice to workers on Sonnet 5.5; Polish and the security review run side by side; agents that did not write the code check it; a second opinion from the other coding agent reviews risky Plans by itself
